header.title: AR glasses shipments double in 2026 driven by Meta and Chinese brands

s01_bottom_line.text: TrendForce forecasts global AR glasses shipments to more than double from 620,000 units in 2025 to 1.31 million in 2026 (111.1% YoY), led by Meta (~20% share) and four brands XREAL, Even Realities, Rokid and RayNeo (combined 53.2%), with nearly 80% further growth expected in 2027. ⟨cited figures: forecast; approximate⟩
AR glasses are transitioning from proof-of-concept to consumer market, and brands are accelerating product development and channels to capture early demand.

Rising AR glasses volumes could benefit the named brands and their display/component supply chains, but the article does not quantify any listed-company revenue, margin or earnings effect, and three of the four non-Meta brands are private.
